def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # --- Базовая таблица: позиции заказов, совершённых строго до seed_time ---
    oi = order_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status",
                "order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    oi = oi[oi["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    # учитываем только интересующие товары
    oi = oi[oi["product_id"].isin(set(entity_ids))]

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    if len(oi) == 0:
        for c in ["sales_last_30d", "sales_last_60d", "sales_last_90d", "sales_last_180d",
                  "sales_last_365d", "total_sold", "total_revenue", "avg_price",
                  "min_price", "max_price", "total_freight", "avg_freight",
                  "freight_share", "distinct_sellers", "distinct_orders",
                  "items_per_order", "avg_review_score", "review_count",
                  "neg_review_share", "review_recency_days",
                  "avg_installments", "avg_payment_value",
                  "days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale",
                  "sales_30d_per_90d", "delivered_orders", "on_time_delivery_share",
                  "avg_delivery_delay", "canceled_share"]:
            features[c] = 0.0
        return features.reindex(entity_ids).astype(float)

    ts_col = "order_purchase_timestamp"

    # 1. Продажи в скользящих окнах
    for w in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        cnt = oi[oi[ts_col] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id").size()
        features[f"sales_last_{w}d"] = cnt.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # тренд: продажи за последние 30d / предыдущие 60d
    s30 = oi[oi[ts_col] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)].groupby("product_id").size()
    s60 = oi[(oi[ts_col] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)) &
             (oi[ts_col] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30))].groupby("product_id").size()
    s30 = s30.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    s90 = oi[oi[ts_col] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby("product_id").size().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    features["sales_30d_per_90d"] = s30 / s90.replace(0, np.nan)
    features["sales_30d_per_90d"] = features["sales_30d_per_90d"].fillna(0)

    # 2. Агрегаты по цене/доставке
    agg = oi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_sold=("order_item_id", "size"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
    )
    agg["freight_share"] = agg["total_freight"] / agg["total_revenue"].replace(0, np.nan)
    for c in agg.columns:
        features[c] = agg[c].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # 3. Разнообразие продавцов и заказов
    features["distinct_sellers"] = oi.groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    n_orders = oi.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    features["distinct_orders"] = n_orders
    features["items_per_order"] = features["total_sold"] / n_orders.replace(0, np.nan)
    features["items_per_order"] = features["items_per_order"].fillna(0)

    prod_orders = oi[["product_id", "order_id", ts_col,
                      "order_delivered_customer_date",
                      "order_estimated_delivery_date",
                      "order_status"]].drop_duplicates()

    # 4. Отзывы: только те, что уже существуют на момент seed_time,
    #    и только по заказам, совершённым до seed_time
    rev = reviews[["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date"]].copy()
    rev = rev[rev["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    rev_merged = prod_orders.merge(rev, on="order_id", how="inner")

    if len(rev_merged) > 0:
        r_agg = rev_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            review_count=("review_score", "size"),
        )
        features["avg_review_score"] = r_agg["avg_review_score"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        features["review_count"] = r_agg["review_count"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        neg = rev_merged.assign(neg=(rev_merged["review_score"] <= 2).astype(float))
        features["neg_review_share"] = neg.groupby("product_id")["neg"].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        last_rev = rev_merged.groupby("product_id")["review_creation_date"].max()
        features["review_recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_rev).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(9999)
    else:
        features["avg_review_score"] = 0.0
        features["review_count"] = 0.0
        features["neg_review_share"] = 0.0
        features["review_recency_days"] = 9999.0

    # 5. Платежи: платежи принадлежат заказу, известны с момента покупки
    pay = payments[["order_id", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]]
    pay_merged = prod_orders.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="inner")
    if len(pay_merged) > 0:
        p_agg = pay_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        )
        features["avg_installments"] = p_agg["avg_installments"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        features["avg_payment_value"] = p_agg["avg_payment_value"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    else:
        features["avg_installments"] = 0.0
        features["avg_payment_value"] = 0.0

    # 6. Давность первой/последней продажи
    first_sale = oi.groupby("product_id")[ts_col].min()
    last_sale = oi.groupby("product_id")[ts_col].max()
    features["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(9999)
    features["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(9999)

    # 7. Доставки: только те, что реально завершились ДО seed_time
    del_mask = (prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()) & \
               (prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    delivered = prod_orders[del_mask].copy()
    if len(delivered) > 0:
        delivered["delay"] = (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                              delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        d_agg = delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
            delivered_orders=("order_id", "size"),
            avg_delivery_delay=("delay", "mean"),
        )
        features["delivered_orders"] = d_agg["delivered_orders"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        features["avg_delivery_delay"] = d_agg["avg_delivery_delay"].reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        on_time = delivered.assign(ot=(delivered["delay"] <= 0).astype(float))
        features["on_time_delivery_share"] = on_time.groupby("product_id")["ot"].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    else:
        features["delivered_orders"] = 0.0
        features["avg_delivery_delay"] = 0.0
        features["on_time_delivery_share"] = 0.0

    # 8. Доля отменённых/недоступных заказов (статус известен на момент seed_time)
    bad = prod_orders["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]).astype(float)
    tmp = prod_orders.assign(bad=bad)
    features["canceled_share"] = tmp.groupby("product_id")["bad"].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    features = features.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return features.reindex(entity_ids)
